assumptions.note: Classifier has no timer-bank taxonomy. D-02/D-03 specify explicit shared-phase, DONE/borrow/link and unavailable-mode predicates; planning must cover them without claiming hardware calibration.
Classifier has no guest-model-detection taxonomy. D-08 requires actual guest probe evidence and a model-mismatch control; a host label is insufficient.
